items.lede: By keeping Skullcandy in Park City, Utah, Bose is betting that skate cred and budget pricing will reach listeners it’s been missing.
items.title: Bose Is Buying Skullcandy. It’s Not as Weird as It Sounds

items.lede: Bose announced today it has acquired Skullcandy. Although the two companies are competitors in the consumer audio space, Skullcandy recently partnered with its new owner to bring several of Bose's audio technologies - including its head-tracking spatial audio and excellent active noise cancellation (ANC) - to products like the Skullcandy Crusher 1080 ANC headphones and […]
items.title: Bose acquires Skullcandy to help it reach a wider audience

items.lede: Bose sees the company as a way to reach a wider audience.
